pr_title: Normalize DOMAIN_REGEX casing and trim domain from JSON Schema conversion
pr_description: Rewrites `DOMAIN_REGEX` to use a lowercase character class with a case-insensitive flag instead of an explicit A-Z range, matching the style of the other string-format regexes in this file. Also removes `domain` from the to-json-schema action converter, since domain validation doesn't have a corresponding JSON Schema keyword to map onto.
